faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the MADFAM Ecosystem.

q1.question: Is the ecosystem membership available yet?
q1.answer: Not yet. Join the waitlist and we will let you know when it opens. We publish no price or final benefits until they are ratified.

q2.question: Is there a free trial?
q2.answer: It depends on each platform: its page says whether it offers a free tier or a trial. You can start with a platform today without waiting for the membership.

q3.question: How do the platforms connect?
q3.answer: Janua provides identity; Enclii, deployment; Dhanam takes payments for the others; Selva coordinates the agents. On that base the applications hand work to each other: a Yantra4D design is quoted in Cotiza, compared in Forgesight, charged in Dhanam, made with Pravara and invoiced with Karafiel.

q4.question: How does the Maker Node discount work?
q4.answer: Ecosystem Members will receive special discounts and benefits on physical fabrication orders through Primavera Maker Node — 3D printing, CNC machining, and laser cutting. Details coming soon.
